With two decades of experience in crafting homes, Srinidhi Constructions brings high-standard living with spectacular appreciation potential near Hyderabad's IT corridors and Outer Ring Road.

specifications.details: RCC Frame Structure engineered to withstand seismic loads.
9" thick external walls and 4.5" internal walls with premium cement bricks.
Main Door: Teak wood frame with veneered flush door. Internal Doors: Engineered wood frames with flush doors.
UPVC windows with glass sliding shutters and integrated mosquito mesh.
Premium quality vitrified tiles for living, dining, and bedrooms. Ceramic tiled flooring for utility. Staircase finished with Granite.
Interiors: Premium emulsion paint (Asian/Berger/Equivalent). Exteriors: Water proof exterior emulsion paint.
Granite platform with stainless steel sink. 2' height ceramic tiled dado above cooking platform.
Anti-skid ceramic tiled flooring, premium wall tiles, and waterproof WPC doors.
Jaquar / Asian bathware or equivalent CP fittings & sanitary ware.
Concealed copper wiring (Finolex/Havells/Finecab/RR Kable). Modular switches (Havells/Legrand/Equivalent).
Johnson or equivalent high-speed passenger lifts.
Generator backup for common area lighting, clubhouse, lifts, water pumps, plus 2 light and 2 fan points in each apartment.
TV points in Living room and Master bedroom; Wi-Fi enabled infrastructure.
Advanced 24/7 security with CCTV surveillance at main entrance gate.

importantNotes: Shelves, Chajjas, Lofts, Arches or structural modifications are not allowed.
Flats will be handed over upon 100% payment only.
Registration, GST, and applicable government taxes extra.
